description: This Java class 'SafeRecovery' provides a utility method to wrap an Akka actor's recovery receive block, ensuring that exceptions during message processing are caught and logged as warnings instead of causing the actor to fail. It enhances the robustness of recovery message handling within Akka-based actor systems.

classes.name: SafeRecovery
classes.description: A utility class providing a safe wrapper for Akka actor recovery message handling that logs exceptions instead of failing.

methods.name: wrapReceive
methods.description: Creates an Akka Receive object that wraps message handling with exception logging, preventing message processing failures from propagating.
